text: This staff report is about a matter which Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services has assessed an appeal from the owner of 104 Mountview Avenue for front yard parking. Front yard parking at this location is not recommended because it does not meet the criteria of the City of Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 918 in that the Code does not permit the licencing of a parking pad where the soft landscaping requirement cannot be provided. Additionally, the Code does not permit the licensing of a front yard parking pad where the required clearance from an existing City tree cannot be met. The owner will be given an opportunity to make a deputation before Community Council.
Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Denied the request for front yard parking at 104 Mountview Avenue.
